en.headline: Digital Policy Office opens applications for robot community pilot
en.dek: Eligible groups may borrow the humanoid Smart Bot free of charge for public events between 15 December and 28 February; the deadline is noon on 20 November.
body: The Digital Policy Office announced on Monday that the first round of the Robots in the Community pilot programme is now open for applications.

Eligible organisations established to serve the public or residents of a Hong Kong district may borrow a humanoid robot named Smart Bot at no cost for free community events. The robot can perform dance and kung fu routines or act as a science ambassador to explain embodied artificial intelligence and other digital technologies.

Events under this round must take place between 15 December 2026 and 28 February 2027. Applications close at noon on 20 November and carry no fee. The office said the scheme aims to give residents direct contact with humanoid robots and raise awareness of embodied AI, particularly among older people and lower-income groups.
Priority may be given to activities organised or supported by the Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau or the Digital Policy Office itself. Details are available on the office’s website.

zh.headline: 數字辦「機器人走入社區」試驗計劃接受申請
zh.dek: 合資格機構可免費借用人形機器人「友智寶」參與12月15日至2月28日的免費社區活動，截止時間為11月20日正午。
body: 數字政策辦公室星期一宣布，「機器人走入社區」試驗計劃首輪即日起接受申請。
在香港為公眾或地區居民服務而成立的機構，可免費借用名為「友智寶」的人形機器人，參與免費社區活動。機器人可表演跳舞及功夫，亦可擔任科普大使，介紹具身智能及其他數碼科技。
本輪活動須於2026年12月15日至2027年2月28日期間舉行。申請截止日期為11月20日正午，費用全免。數字辦表示，計劃旨在讓市民近距離接觸人形機器人，提升對具身智能的認識，特別是長者及基層群體。
由創新科技及工業局或數字辦主辦或支持的活動可能獲優先考慮。詳情可瀏覽數字辦網頁。
